title: Answer: time is epochal, a succession of atomic becomings that perish

statements.text: Time is the passage of atomic occasions, each of which becomes as a whole and then perishes into the datum of its successors, which is Locke’s perpetual perishing correctly understood. The irreversibility of time is the reason, Desmet argues, that Whitehead made becoming atomic.

sources.quote: There is a becoming of continuity, but no continuity of becoming.
Henceforth he conceived of the passage of nature as atomic, as constituted by atomic events.
